pieces.Text: This +1 leather armor is made of kimlé and resembles a snug light coat with a tattered lower fringe in the shape of trailing seaweed. The wearer of a kimlé coat gains a +5 bonus on Swim checks. Once per day, the wearer can breathe water for 1 minute.
